statements.statement: The clinical indication note documents recurrent presyncope and near-syncope attributed to symptomatic bradycardia in the setting of sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a background of atherosclerotic heart disease
The service was ordered to correlate syncopal events with underlying arrhythmias and assess for potential ischemic triggers
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The denial is based on bundling into another covered procedure
